item.title: Surveying the genetic battlefield to uncover the rules of rapid evolution
item.description: The Malik Lab thrives on competition. But for HHMI investigator Harmit Malik and his team at the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, it's the genomes—not the people—that are in conflict.
